families.processor: Pillow bilinear thumbnail, bicubic resize, centered byte-zero pad, RGB normalize to [-1,1], 960x1280
families.tokenizer: XLM-R SentencePiece unigram plus audited added CORD tags; fairseq model-id offset preserved
families.schema: cord-v2.donut-tags.v1; bounded balanced tag parser; no repair
families.kv: 4 layers, 16 heads, dimension 64; self past grows to 53; cross past fixed at 1200
families.backends: ONNX Runtime CPU ONNX and OpenVINO CPU FP32 IR
families.unsupported: multi-page execution, caller OCR injection, sampling, Beam, arbitrary schemas, tool calling, TensorRT

families.processor: 224x224 RGB image plus caller words and integer boxes normalized to 0..1000
families.tokenizer: RoBERTa BPE with token-word alignment, special-token boxes, maximum 512
families.blocker: The official base checkpoint has no downstream task head; the previously named Microsoft FUNSD checkpoint was unavailable from the official namespace. The selected license is noncommercial CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0.

families.processor: official 16x16 flattened patches with row/column coordinate prefix, maximum 2048 patches
families.blocker: No complete official or traceable dynamic-patch Encoder/Prefill/Decode ONNX plus OpenVINO bundle was available; official text_config.use_cache is false, so no KV contract is invented.

ownership: DocumentUnderstandingSession owns exact named backend sessions and one Profile/artifact/processor/OCR/schema/source-page-bound encoded document state. Registry, tokenizer, external files, and prepared documents remain caller-owned. Mutable KV is request-local; results and the final KV summary own their data.
publication: External metadata only. uploaded=false, downloadable=false, redistributionAllowed=false. Local execution never upgrades AlgorithmVerified or authorizes a Release asset.
